Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: REAL TWELVE-FRAME combat animation sprite atlas for a giant lava serpent boss in Kiba, a detailed painted Japanese fantasy side-scroller.
References: image1 gives the game's crisp richly painted demonic black rock, orange magma cracks, dark outlined detail; use its MIDDLE demon boss row for style/material only, not the humanoid anatomy. Image2 gives restrained molten rock colors only, not a background.
Create ONE animation atlas, exactly 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows, 12 separate same-size cells. Preferred native canvas2048×1536, cells512×512, at least384×384 native percell. No drawn grid or labels. Every cell contains exactly one complete version of the SAME massive serpentine lava demon facing LEFT, including full head, coiled long limbless body and tapered tail. Tail on RIGHT, eye on LEFT. No legs, hands, wings, held weapons or humanoid torso. Dark cool obsidian overlapping scale plates, narrow molten orange cracks between some plates, red ember fins along spine, pale slate-gray edge highlights, gold-yellow eyes, pale curved fangs. Most body stays cool dark rock so readable above red lava. Crisp inked edges and dense painted shading like reference enemies, NOT flat vector or simple cartoon.
Maintain consistent identity, scale, facing direction, coil base ground line at roughly86% of each cell, head/eye around35% fromleft and35% fromtop in resting poses. Full horns, jaw, tailtip and every fin stay inside their own cell with at least5% transparent gutters; no sprite overlaps or surrounding flame cloud.
Frames left-to-right, top-to-bottom, clearly different body, head and jaw deformation, not copies:
Row1 = 1 breathing idle coils low mouth closed; 2 idle neck lifted slightly jaw still closed tail flexed; 3 idle relaxed exhale neck lower; 4 attack windup neck retracts and head draws back, eyes narrow.
Row2 = 5 stronger windup neck curved far back and jaw halfopen; 6 maximum windup raised head and widely open jaw exposing fangs; 7 bite release head lunges sharply LEFT and downward, mouth open; 8 full bite extension jaws snap nearly shut neck stretches and coil tightens.
Row3 = 9 bite completion jaws closed head low and forward, tail whipped; 10 recovery head lifts and jaw relaxes; 11 recovery coils reform neck retracts; 12 back to neutral coil, near frame1 for smooth loop.
This must be a useable production sprite sheet, NOT a concept page, no scenery/pedestal/ground, no title/numbers/typography/watermark. Fully transparent alpha across all background and gutters; only the serpent itself. No orange backdrop, no drop shadow plate, no white flash or effect obscuring anatomy.
